title: Brown Derby Riff: Bertram's Cap
ldInstructionsRaw: Shake the first 3 ingredients with ice to chill. Prepare a chilled glass by rinsing it with the salt solution, then discarding the excess. Strain the cocktail into the glass. Garnish.
Sea-salt solutionCombine 1 Tbsp. of sea salt with 4 Tbsp. of water, then stir until dissolved.
